mechanism: Dronedarone is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase levetiracetam levels; levetiracetam may increase dronedarone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition, with additive CNS and cardiac effects possible.
action: Monitor for levetiracetam toxicity (dizziness, ataxia, behavioral changes) and dronedarone efficacy; consider ECG monitoring and renal function assessment; dose adjustment may be needed.
